premises.text: Stigma, distrust of healthcare, long wait lists, and trial-and-error antidepressant prescribing block effective depression treatment
premises.evidence_span: why don't patients get treatment for depression

premises.text: Existing biomarkers (DNA, mRNA, proteins) fail to be simultaneously predictive, stable, and measurable for depression
premises.evidence_span: there are no good biomarkers that exist today

premises.text: Circular RNA in blood is a stable, predictive biomarker usable for diagnosing and guiding mental-health treatment
premises.evidence_span: use a new biomarker called circular RNA to help diagnose, monitor treatment, and monitor treatment of mental health conditions

premises.text: A lab pipeline of circRNA-specific qPCR and analytics profiles patients to predict depression and medication response
premises.evidence_span: we use a process called quantitative, circRNA-specific quantitative PCR

premises.text: Primary care, telemedicine, and urgent care channels need faster, clearer depression diagnostic workflows
premises.evidence_span: Primary care, telemedicine, and urgent care

premises.text: The same circular-RNA platform can extend to early detection in oncology and neurology
premises.evidence_span: The platform that our company is developing does not only apply to mental health care

domains.name: Depression care access and biomarker gap

value.text: Precision medicine for mental health that improves diagnosis and treatment selection and patient outcomes
value.evidence_span: bring precision medicine to mental health diagnostics and therapeutics

secondary_value.text: Biological basis that can help reduce stigma around depression
secondary_value.evidence_span: helps remove the stigma that revolves around depression by giving it a biological basis
